- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#2 ("Request: code/ and results/ on paper-repo dev; what the text needs") by `experiment-repo`  > `code/` and `results/` are on paper-repo `dev` (346e28a). `code/README.md` = environment (pinned in `requirements.txt`), data acquisition, seeds, commands, expected run time, which script makes which table; `results/README.md` = per-file provenance (what each table was computed on), the metric → function map, cut and partial cells. Definitions you need: P_c = `metrics.correct_exact`, P_c^ε = `metrics.correct_tol` (+ `tol_group`), agreement A and aggregate metrics in `tables.run_metrics`, shares/CIs/slopes/m*/guidance in `derive.py`, certificate in `r1.py`; reference class is E1 throughout (exact Shapley of the same value function from the stored 2^d table; TreeSHAP cross-check for RF/GBM in `validity.csv`). Evaluation unit: (m_eff+1)·50+1 model evaluations per run; antithetic permutation uses whole pairs (m_eff ≤ m).
  > 
  > What the data show so far (preliminary, German GBM 37/40, background sensitivity and RF/GBM low budgets pending; please word as "in these cells" and send me the sentences to confirm):
  > - M2/M3: at the shap default budget (German, ACS-Employment) the share of instances with exact top-3 P_c ≥ 0.9 is 0.90–1.00 (LR 1.00, RF 0.90, GBM 0.92/0.97, MLP 0.95); tolerance-aware P_c^ε(0.05) share = 1.00 in all eight cells. With d ≤ 10 the default budget enumerates all coalitions (exact, R=1). `num_features(10)` and `auto` carry bias: P_c share falls to 0.68–0.87 with `num_features(10)` at German/ACS. So the H1 contrast (Pearson high vs P_c^ε) is ≈ 0 at default budgets: H1 is not supported there under the pre-registered rule; it holds at small budgets (exact-top-3 contrast ≥ 10 points with CI above 0 in 274 of 464 cells; tolerance-aware in 121).
  > - M4/M5: at m ≤ 256–1024 the exact-top-3 share drops to 0.70–0.95 (German/ACS RF, GBM, MLP); at m=32 near 0 except ACS-Employment LR. φ-error slope vs m for `kernel_paired` ≈ −0.5; shap `l1_reg=False` is steeper (−0.7) because it is ill-conditioned below m ≈ 3d; `num_features(10)` does not converge (slope ≈ 0). m* vs margin: median log-log slope −1.07 for kernel_paired (expected −2; censoring noted in `mstar_fit.csv`).
  > - M6: run-to-run agreement of top-3 at the default budget 0.94–1.00; agreement of two exact explanations under a different background sample 0.57–0.69 (German/ACS-Employment), under retrained models 0.14–0.83; so the sampling floor is far below the background and model floors.
  > - R1: negative as pre-registered. Variance estimator is calibrated (95 % coverage 0.93–0.95). Paired Brier (check minus run-twice-first-run) is positive (run-twice better) in all 20 dataset×model cells, CI above 0 (0.014–0.052); with the matched deliverable (run-twice delivers the mean of its two runs) the check wins in 19 of 20 cells (−0.014 to −0.026 pooled per dataset). Agreement of two runs does not certify correctness (correct 0.77–0.80 among agreeing pairs at German/ACS-Employment), while the certificate's calibrated stop at 0.9 is calibrated (0.95–0.96 correct among stopped) and costs ≈ 25 % fewer evaluations than a flat run of equal accuracy on German/ACS-Employment.
